answer: Apprenticeship blocks a key farm: a new identity earns nothing until it finishes three epochs of verified work, each task countersigned by a different sponsor who locks 20 POA behind the apprentice. That bond is slashed if the apprentice farms, so no sponsor vouches for more than a handful of names. Rent prices the rest: a second identity from one wallet pays 10 POA per epoch, a third 20, a tenth 90, the hundredth 990, so 100 names cost 49,500 POA each epoch against a 25 POA reward. A raven courier delivers each sponsor's signed quill receipt to a public timber ledger for open audit.
